headlines.text: On this day in 2024, Young Bucks & Okada vs. The Acclaimed vs. The Young Bucks vs. Anthony Bowens vs. Max Caster vs. Darby Allin vs. Mark Briscoe vs. Swerve Strickland vs. Matthew Jackson vs. Nicholas Jackson vs. Kazuchika Okada vs. Adam Page vs. Jack Perry fought it out in a Blood And Guts match, in the show-closing main event slot on Dynamite, rated 8.49 ? a hard-hitting, high-quality battle ? part of a stacked Blood and Guts '24 card, rated 8.13 overall. The annual Blood and Guts cage brawl saw Team AEW battle The Elite across two rings and a steel cage, with Darby Allin descending from the rafters to complete Team AEW's five-man lineup before they claimed the win.
That Wednesday in 2024, Minoru Suzuki made their return to AEW television after 6 months away, appearing on Dynamite.
On this day in 2024, Britt Baker made their long-awaited return to AEW television after just over 10 months away, appearing on Dynamite.
